title: Link in bio personal page
when: The user wants a simple personal page with a photo, a bio and a list of links.
prompt:
Goal: A tiny, fast page with big, clear link buttons that work on any phone.
Steps:
1. Avatar with alt, name as h1 and a one line bio.
2. Links as a list of full width anchors with clear labels and 48 px tall targets.
3. External links open in the same tab unless the user asks otherwise; if new tab, add rel="noopener".
4. Optional featured link highlighted with text, not only color.
5. Keep everything in one HTML file with a small style block.
Quality bar:
- Loads instantly.
- Every link label says where it goes.
- Contrast passes on the chosen theme.
Pitfalls:
- Icon only links without names.
- Tracking scripts.
- Tiny tap targets.
Verify:
- [ ] Each link has visible text.
- [ ] rel="noopener" on new tab links.
- [ ] Contrast passes.
- [ ] One h1.
Output: index.html with inline styles.

examples.input: página de links para meu perfil
examples.output: photo, name, bio, 6 big link buttons: shop, portfolio, contact email
